/pedrapas.title: Pedra Pas - My Framer Site
/pedrapas.description: AI Specialist and photographer. Design and innovation
p:
This project originated from a deeply rooted tradition in an iconic establishment in my hometown. My grandfather, a former sailor, frequented this bar to enjoy games and savor delicious appetizers.

This long-established, nautical-themed bar lacked a graphic update that reflected its essence in a contemporary way. To create the brand identity for this project, we drew inspiration from the characteristic aesthetic of traditional seafood restaurants and bars, giving it a modern graphic touch.

For the visual identity design, we opted for a simple and welcoming aesthetic that conveys familiarity and evokes a rustic atmosphere. We also aim to transmit a sense of freshness and order, in keeping with the quality and organization that characterize the establishment's culinary offerings.

/ayeaye.title: AYE AYE - My Framer Site
/ayeaye.description: AI Specialist and photographer. Design and innovation
p:
Throughout the years, we have witnessed various forms of social discrimination due to multiple factors such as social class, gender, race, ideology, among others. One of the causes that divides society into different groups is the difference in clothing. In the realm of cultures, subcultures, and styles, numerous cases of discrimination have occurred. The fashion industry itself has contributed significantly to this situation.

Although in recent years, certain types of clothing and subcultures have started to be accepted in the fashion world, there are still everyday events that harm the lives of some individuals. These events include rejection at the entrance to certain establishments, disdainful looks on the street, negative comments on social media, and unnecessary opinions, among other ongoing occurrences.


The project consists of a punk fashion magazine, considered the pioneer of protest fashion. One of the main objectives of this movement is to express discontent towards society and the imposed norms. The idea is to continue in the future with possible volumes on other movements within alternative fashion, such as gothic fashion, hippie fashion, among others.

/djone.title: Djone - My Framer Site
/djone.description: AI Specialist and photographer. Design and innovation
p: I hadn't used my camera in ages, and one day, over coffee and conversation, the idea came up to do a beach-inspired photoshoot with a friend of mine who's starting out as a DJ in Galicia. We set off, armed with a powerful flashlight and freezing cold. We ventured onto the beach at 2 a.m., with no real faith that our ideas would work. Here's the result of a session that was anything but improvised and had limited resources.

/china.title: China - My Framer Site
/china.description: AI Specialist and photographer. Design and innovation
p:
A few years ago, I wrote down a goal in my school notebook for my 20s: to travel to Asia. Today, at 24, I can say I've achieved that goal with one of the most incredible trips of my life.

It was an experience shared with my WeRoad group. I know that during the trip, many didn't quite understand why I always had my camera in hand. Today, seeing the result of all those photos and this video, I hope you can see what my eyes were capturing.

China is a fascinating blend of past and future that has changed my perspective. I'm sharing this short summary of what was an unforgettable adventure.
